# MCP setup fixtures

These files describe the smallest supported project-scoped configuration
shapes. They contain no credentials and are used only as parser and merge
fixtures.

- Claude Code: `.mcp.json`, `mcpServers.lazydb`
- Codex: `.codex/config.toml`, `mcp_servers.lazydb`
- OpenCode: `opencode.json` or `opencode.jsonc`, `mcp.lazydb`
